metadata.description: Live-captured via bin/mock-capture against <internal-env>/26.2.0.0, org group 138883 (sdktest), the recapture epic's Group A retry. Resolves AppsV2Service.GetAssignmentRuleAsync. HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED: {applicationUuid} is the SAME identifier space as the internal-apps endpoints' own app UUID -- a real internal iOS app was created via tools/internalapps-capture (device_type=Apple, model_name=iPhone) for this call, and its own Uuid field (from the app's GET response) worked directly as the {applicationUuid} path param, no separate discovery needed. This corroborates the X-API-Warning seen on the deprecated PUT /api/mam/apps/internal/{applicationId}/assignments endpoint (a sibling capture), which pointed at this exact replacement route. 200, real success -- a freshly created app has no assignment rule configured yet, so assignments/excluded_smart_groups are empty and application_msi_deployment_params is an empty object. App deleted at session end; deletion confirmed via post-delete GET (401/errorCode 7000).
